JAVA_HOME = /usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64
JAVA_LIBS = -L/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/lib/server -ljvm
JAVA_CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/include -I/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/include/linux
LDFLAGS = -L/usr/local/lib
SHLIB_CFLAGS =
SHLIB_CXXFLAGS =
SHLIB_CXXLD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++
SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX11LD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++11
SHLIB_CXX11LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX14LD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++14
SHLIB_CXX14LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX17LD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++17
SHLIB_CXX17LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX20LD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++20
SHLIB_CXX20LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX23LD = clang++-16 -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++23
SHLIB_CXX23LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_EXT = .so
SHLIB_FFLAGS =
SHLIB_LD = clang-16
SHLIB_LDFLAGS = -shared
TCLTK_CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/include/tcl8.6 -I/usr/include/tcl8.6
TCLTK_LIBS = -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltcl8.6 -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltk8.6 -lX11 -lXss -lXext
BLAS_LIBS = -lblas
LAPACK_LIBS = -llapack
MAKE = make
LIBnn = lib
AR = ar
NM = /usr/bin/nm -B
RANLIB = ranlib
LTO =
LTO_FC =
LTO_LD =

TCLTK_CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/include/tcl8.6 -I/usr/include/tcl8.6
TCLTK_LIBS = -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltcl8.6 -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltk8.6 -lX11 -lXss -lXext
BLAS_LIBS = -lblas
LAPACK_LIBS = -llapack
MAKE = make
LIBnn = lib
AR = ar
NM = /usr/bin/nm -B
RANLIB = ranlib
LTO =
LTO_FC =
LTO_LD =

JAVA_LIBS = -L/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/lib/server -ljvm
JAVA_CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/include -I/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64/include/linux
LDFLAGS = -L/usr/local/lib
SHLIB_CFLAGS =
SHLIB_CXXFLAGS =
SHLIB_CXXLD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++17
SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX11LD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++11
SHLIB_CXX11LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX14LD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++14
SHLIB_CXX14LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX17LD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++17
SHLIB_CXX17LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX20LD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++20
SHLIB_CXX20LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_CXX23LD = clang++ -stdlib=libc++ -std=gnu++2b
SHLIB_CXX23LDFLAGS = -shared
SHLIB_EXT = .so
SHLIB_FFLAGS =
SHLIB_LD = clang
SHLIB_LDFLAGS = -shared
TCLTK_CPPFLAGS = -I/usr/include/tcl8.6 -I/usr/include/tcl8.6
TCLTK_LIBS = -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltcl8.6 -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -ltk8.6 -lX11 -lXss -lXext
BLAS_LIBS = -L/opt/R/devel-rchk/lib/R/lib -lRblas
LAPACK_LIBS = -L/opt/R/devel-rchk/lib/R/lib -lRlapack
MAKE = make
LIBnn = lib
AR = ar
NM = /usr/bin/nm -B
RANLIB = ranlib
LTO =
LTO_FC =
LTO_LD =

MAKE = make
LIBnn = lib
AR = ar
NM = /usr/bin/nm -B
RANLIB = ranlib
LTO =
LTO_FC =
LTO_LD =
